done_when: forge work merges the default branch into the item's branch before every work round, and when close finds a merge conflict it offers a short resolve-only round instead of a full worker round; a test covers both on a new and an adopted repo
why: Closes fail with 'merging main conflicts in ...' and each costs a whole worker round, and rounds that start on a stale base show diffs that seem to delete main's newer files (issue 969)
